svg.text: Hookup points the doubles/triples test covers (handbook Section 7 / 6.4)

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
text.tspan: • Converter dolly: a coupling device with a fifth wheel, one or more axles, a pintle hook/drawbar eye, and
air/electrical connections. It converts a semitrailer so it can be towed behind another trailer.
• Secure the dolly: safety chains or cables, lock the pintle, couple the fifth wheel to the rear trailer (jaws on
the shank, no gap), and raise the dolly landing gear / hook the carry-all as equipped.
• Air lines: connect properly (service and emergency). Know which shut-off valves must be OPEN (to the rear
trailers you are towing) and which must be CLOSED (at the last trailer, so air does not escape).
• Never back a pair of trailers more than a short distance -- rearward amplification (Figure DT-2) makes the rear
trailer swing farther than the tractor.
• After coupling, do a combination brake check: charge the trailers, test the trailer hand valve (do not use it for
parking), and make sure you have air all the way to the last trailer.
